what.text: This page follows refugees from Kyrgyzstan living in Russia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 49 Kyrgyz refugees in Russia, 1.5% of all refugees from Kyrgyzstan.
The United States hosts the most Kyrgyz refugees, followed by France, Germany and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Kyrgyzstan: an interstate armed conflict with Tajikistan in 2021 and 2022.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1996 and 1997, come long before it.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at its highest figure, 17081 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1996 and 1997, and the figure has fallen since.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Russia.
These are year-end totals for Russia only, reported to UNHCR.
